decisions.decision: Pursued progressive hardening for the release race: j5j (ignoreReservationId) → ke1 (ignoreItemId) → 08n (extend status-flip effect to pass nav state)
decisions.rationale: Each iteration closed a discovered race path. 08n was the final piece — Firestore onSnapshot fires faster than useReleaseReservation's setStatus('success'), so the status-flip useEffect won the navigation race. Without state, j5j/ke1 guards had nothing to match.

decisions.decision: Discarded all diagnostic console + localStorage logging after diagnosis
decisions.rationale: Diag logs were uncommitted (lived only in main checkout) and noise for production. 08n executor confirmed grep for DIAG|diagLog|__DIAG__ returns zero in committed code.

decisions.decision: Adapted ItemReservePage state machine to handle the auto-reserve flow (RegistryPage.tsx:91 onSuccess) AND the direct mutation flow (ItemReservePage.tsx:54 onSuccess) consistently
decisions.rationale: Anonymous-no-identity users go through RegistryPage's autoReserveMutation; signed-in / anonymous-with-identity go through ItemReservePage's reserveMutation. Both now flow through the same release path that passes nav state.
